description: Calculate the d-band center of the RuO2(110) surface from projected density of states.
user_prompt: Calculate the d-band center of the RuO2(110) surface (rutile structure, P4_2/mnm). RuO2 is a metallic (conductive) oxide, so treat it with plain PBE and do not apply a Hubbard U correction to Ru. Extract the d-band center (in eV relative to the Fermi level) from the surface Ru atoms' d-orbital projected DOS and report the final value.

references: Ping, Liu, Zheng, Song, Guo, Chen, and Wei, Nat. Commun. 15, 2501 (2024).
method.modeling: Use a rutile RuO2(110) slab and project the DOS on surface Ru atoms, preferably the coordinatively unsaturated top-layer Ru sites.
method.rationale: Ping et al. report the pristine RuO2(110) surface Ru 4d band center as -1.759 eV at plain PBE, with the surface O 2p center at -3.365 eV as a useful consistency check. Their calculations use VASP/PAW/GGA-PBE without a Hubbard U, a four-layer Ru-O slab, top two layers relaxed, and 2x2x1/4x4x1 k-point meshes for optimization/DOS. The scored quantity is the surface Ru 4d centroid relative to E_F, matching the benchmark full_d_band_centers_rel_fermi_eV convention. The 0.4 eV absolute tolerance covers CUS-vs-bridge or surface-Ru averaging choices, smearing, k-point convergence, and DOS integration-window differences.
